question: If a + b =11 and ab = 35, then what is the value of (a⁴ + b⁴)?
solution:
Given:

a + b = 11 and ab = 35

Concept used:

1. (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

2. a² + b² = (a + b)² - 2ab

Calculation:

a + b = 11

⇒ (a + b)² = 11² (Taking square on both sides)

⇒ a² + 2ab + b² = 121

⇒ (a² + b²) = 121 - 2 × 35

⇒ (a2 + b2) = 51 ....(1)

Now, (a4 + b4)

⇒ (a²)² + (b²)²

⇒ (a² + b²)² - 2a²b²

⇒ (51)² - 2 × 35² (From 1)

⇒ 151

∴ The required value is 151.
